fidelity_missingness_analysis.claim_boundary: Availability describes whether the automatic response-to-TreeSHAP comparison could be computed; it is not a human correctness score.
fidelity_missingness_analysis.unit: generated condition record within dataset and condition

gate_analysis.claim_boundary: The gate split is descriptive and is not an estimate of detector accuracy or a causal guardrail effect.
gate_analysis.purpose: describe exposure to the 0.50 pre-generation gate

latency_by_disposition_analysis.claim_boundary: These are post-hoc descriptive timings. Disposition groups are outcomes of the pipeline and are not randomized comparison groups.
latency_by_disposition_analysis.unit: condition record within dataset, condition, and disposition

scope_boundary: Derived only from accepted immutable raw records; no model, retrieval, guardrail, panel, protocol, or V4 re-execution or alteration.
